review.binding_check: The two reviewed blobs are identical in candidate707a92c; this is a Git identity check, not a repeat source review or claim that Astra reviewed the commit by SHA.

recommendation.model: MobileSAM vit_t; exact upstream checkpoint as offline conversion input

checkpoint.role: conversion input only; not an Android-loadable model

recommendation.runtime: Standalone LiteRT CompiledModel API, GPU + separate explicit CPU sessions; no Google Play runtime or vendor NPU package initially
recommendation.artifact_verification: Public HTTPS responses stream-hashed under exact byte caps; no binary retained, deserialized, executed, installed or published. No production license admission IDs created.
required_deployable_artifacts: Exact separately callable encoder.tflite and prompt_decoder.tflite plus a deterministic manifest binding both full SHA256s, tensor layouts/dtypes/shapes, preprocessing and inverse resize/padding mapping, threshold/mask selection policy, source checkpoint and converter/toolchain hashes.
Derived hashes are OPEN: these files do not exist in this lane. Do not fill AssistedSelectionPins.modelArtifactSha256 with the upstream .pt hash or a fabricated .tflite hash.

Hash the canonical model manifest for modelArtifactSha256, then verify every child artifact; hash an exact runtime manifest for runtimeArtifactSha256 and every child AAR/native runtime identity. These are proposed manifest semantics, not a changed shared API or closed admission.
Record exact converter/runtime transitive licenses and notices in the current gates; POM declarations alone do not prove bundled-native notice completeness.

Initial conversion must use operators supported by the admitted standalone CPU/GPU runtime without Flex/Select-TF/custom or vendor delegate additions; any such dependency changes need their own exact artifact/license admission. Float is a reference candidate, not proof of fitting the pool; quantized derivatives require new hashes and quality evidence.
interface: Implement existing AssistedSelectionBackend.admit -> Runtime.encode -> Session.propose/close in NEW Android leaves only after root grants ownership.
admit verifies actual artifacts, closed license/runtime admissions, tensor/operator support, CPU capability and conservative total workingSetBytes without loading weights/source/embeddings.
Use existing SessionResources before allocations; stay within unchanged256MiB process pool including 20P+16MiB import reservation and source/render concurrent charges; refuse rather than exceed.

Read original pixels through an admitted existing source/decoder owner with actual hash, orientation and source/epoch/page/revision fences. Common source metadata is not pixel access. No display-background screenshot as original, no duplicate decoder/manager.

Encode once per admitted source; retain actual embeddings. Decode real positive/negative points and boxes against original-D mapping; validate exact export shape/count support, never silently drop/truncate/pad prompts with unverified semantics.

GPU and CPU capability names require observed real execution/provider support. A settled Unsupported preferred initialization may choose admitted CPU once; no retries on inference, cancellation or storage failures. Join producer/close before releasing charges and retain failed owners.
Postprocess bounded mask to full oriented D coverage with actual sequence/source identity, then reuse existing proposal/Accept/ImportCoverage/manual correction/undo paths.
why_not_other_shortcuts: Official MobileSAM export_onnx_model.py exports prompt encoder/mask decoder only; it does not supply an Android image encoder.
Android NNAPI is deprecated since Android15; official Android guidance recommends alternatives for performance critical workloads. No new NNAPI-dependent backend recommended.

Qualcomm preexports are a potential source reference, not an admitted deployment: inspected card has no exact S23/8Gen2 acceptance evidence and reports encoder peak memory above256MiB on several other phone targets. Current inspected recipe defaults one point; it cannot be assumed to support the whole prompt contract.
Qualcomm custom export uses credentialed hosted AI Hub work, forbidden by current no-credential/no-external-model-call scope. No such call was made.
approvals_and_limits: Parent must grant exact new Android backend/test paths and retain coordinator ownership of dependency manifests/lock, license records, source-pixel ports and actual app roots.

Ordinary Apache-2.0 candidate review can use current allowlist; exact model/runtime/transitive notices and local derived artifact admission still must close. No user signature/terms acceptance inferred.

Any gated weights, Qualcomm/vendor proprietary SDK or license terms, credential creation, cloud compile/profile/inference, binary publication or pool increase requires explicit authority outside this research; none is proposed as an automatic next action.
Heavy offline conversion/build and device work require parent allocation of the shared slot and applicable device authorization. No heavy check/inference/device operation ran.

SEL-001 remains open until actual S23 GPU/NPU prompt end-to-end <=100ms after one encoding, real CPU fallback, source/prompt correctness, cancellation/cleanup and manual correction/undo are demonstrated with current-source receipts.
tensor_contract_open: Exact encoder/decoder artifact hashes and their pair/manifest identity; neither deployable artifact exists in this lane.
Actual tensor names, dimensions, layouts, dtypes and supported operator sets for both CPU and GPU; do not assume checkpoint/ONNX metadata equals a converted LiteRT contract.
Verified oriented-source RGB/color/normalization, resize/padding rules and exact inverse mapping from model masks back to full D coverage.
Positive/negative point and box encoding; supported counts under the existing64-point bound, sentinel semantics and dynamic-shape behavior. No silent prompt truncation or unverified padding.
Actual embeddings and decoder mask/score outputs; deterministic mask selection, threshold/resampling and output coverage policy validated against reference outputs.
Conservative loaded-runtime/weights/activation/source/embedding/scratch/import peak and cancellation/retirement behavior, admitted before allocations within the unchanged process pool.
